description: This charming fountain has a dark brown body with a slate texture. This model comes with one cracked clear glass, two color changing LED lights, eight raining spouts and authentic river rocks included for additional beauty. The fountain composition is 80% plastic/15% electrical hardware/5% glass. Dual power options: run this fountain off a standard 3 volt pin AC adapter or 2 "AA" batteries (both not included). This beautiful fountain makes an affordable, inexpensive gift for any occasion, such as Mother's & Father's Day, birthdays, retirement, housewarming celebrations, engagement parties, anniversary gifts for parents, relatives, friends, "get well" gifts, employee gift exchanges and is perfect for any holiday season. It also makes a fantastic grab and go gift for those last minute parties and get together! It's wonderful for personal relaxation by listening to the soothing sounds of rainfall. Enjoy the color changing effects that look beautiful in a dim room or in the evening on the outside patio table.: it will enhance any kitchen counter, table, fireplace, coffee table, dinner table, patio table, front desk, night stand, or on top shelf. Intended for indoor use and outdoor usage is possible! This fountain is 10.5 inches tall; 6 inches long; 4 inches wide and packed in a retail color box.
